baseline_method: 80 holdout annotations from distinct images, excluding development image IDs and byte-identical files; 12 equally spaced perimeter anchors from ground truth; 12 independent product path searches including closing interval; symmetric mean and maximum sampled nearest-segment distance on complete contours only; strict crossings only, no full topology or garment-pattern validation
alternative_method: 80 holdout annotations from distinct images, excluding development image IDs and byte-identical files; 12 equally spaced perimeter anchors from ground truth; 12 independent base-cost 0.03 experimental path searches including closing interval; symmetric mean and maximum sampled nearest-segment distance on complete contours only; strict crossings only, no full topology or garment-pattern validation
method: Any segment with symmetric raster-point disagreement exceeding a fixed radius; scored against baseline sampled local error over 5 px. Ground-truth-derived anchors; exploratory, not user or physical validation.
segment_method: Baseline raster vertices to nearest annotation segment, one direction only; omission of unvisited boundary is not detected. Threshold strictly greater than 5 pixels.
